createdDuring: Core registry created during the NASA Space Apps 2026 event window on 14 Nov 2026, from sources acquired 12:10-12:25 UTC that day. Revision r2 on 15 Nov corrects acquisition status and qualifies the 981 s passage. The separately versioned investigation atlas, condition cases and detector readings retain their own later acquisition provenance; they are not silently added as core model-assessment findings.
reviewStatement: All records are assistant-checked against event-time acquired bytes. No independent human review has taken place.
